name: Wixx
review:
Wixx is an early 5x3 gem slot built around crystal boosters. A four-of-a-kind on red crystals awards a respin where the reds turn into stacked wilds, yellow crystals give a respin where crystal pays are multiplied by x5, and sapphires have their own booster.

Nolimit rates it Medium volatility, with a 96.61% RTP and a 2,796x cap. A tidy, classic gem game.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
